name: p1-king-golden
js: (()=>{const app=window.__CITY_APP;const P=app.subway.entrances.pylons,S=app.subway.entrances.sites;let p=P[0],bd=1e9;for(const e of P){const d=Math.hypot(e.x-(376),e.z-(-338));if(d<bd){bd=d;p=e}}let s=S[0],sd=1e9;for(const e of S){const d=Math.hypot(e.pylon.x-p.x,e.pylon.z-p.z);if(d<sd){sd=d;s=e}}const tx=s.tx,tz=s.tz,cx=-s.curbSide.x,cz=-s.curbSide.z;const px=p.x-tx*9+cx*1.6,pz=p.z-tz*9+cz*1.6;app.teleportTo(px-tx*30,pz-tz*30,0);const cam={pos:[px,p.y+1.6,pz],look:[p.x+cx*0.6,p.y+2.2,p.z+cz*0.6],fov:55};app.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>cam;console.log('[cam] p1-king-golden '+p.station+' '+JSON.stringify(cam));})()
